BLOCK 1 — 0–20s — GARAGE GLIDE

@Image1 = Skater, early 20s, cropped silver puffer jacket, white roller skates with pink wheels, dark braids
@Image2 = Empty multi-storey parking garage at night, magenta and cyan neon strip lights, wet concrete

In each character sheet, take the face from the LEFT chest-up portrait panel. The centre panel omits the head deliberately. The skater has a head and face in every shot.

Continuous scene. No dialogue. No music — the track is added in the edit. Dry night, wet floor from a leak.
The skater travels LEFT to RIGHT across frame in every wide. Her braids hang over her RIGHT shoulder.

0–4.8s: Low tracking shot, 24mm, camera at skate height gliding alongside on her RIGHT. @Image1 skates through @Image2 in long smooth strides, arms loose, neon lines streaking across the wet concrete reflections. Match @Image2's magenta and cyan strips exactly.
Audio: urethane wheels rolling on concrete, a distant hum of fluorescent ballast.

4.8–7.2s: Cut. Insert, 50mm, close on the skates. Pink wheels cut through a shallow puddle, spray catching cyan light.
Audio: a hiss of water at 5.5s.

7.2–12s: Cut. Wide, 18mm, locked-off at the end of a ramp. @Image1 enters frame LEFT, carves a slow full circle under a magenta strip, and exits frame RIGHT.
Audio: wheels, a soft echo off the ceiling.

12–14.4s: Cut. Close-up, 85mm, handheld, tracking backward. @Image1 looks straight down the lens, chin level, braids lifting with the speed.
Audio: wind past the mic.

14.4–20s: Cut. Extreme wide, 24mm, from the top of the ramp. @Image1 drops down the ramp into the dark lower level, small in frame, until only the neon strips remain. (Final 0.8 s is trimmed to the bar in the edit.)
Audio: wheels fading, the ballast hum.

NEGATIVE: no music, no lip-sync, no text or signage, no other people, no cars, no slow motion.

Style DNA:
Shot on ARRI Alexa 35 with anamorphic prime lenses. Smooth tracking moves at skate height unless a shot specifies locked-off or handheld. Photoreal live-action cinematography, no stylisation. Practical magenta and cyan neon strips as the only light sources, saturated pools reflecting on wet concrete, deep blacks, cyan shadows. Soft horizontal lens flares from the strips. 24fps, 180-degree shutter, fine 35mm grain, shallow depth of field. Electric, free, nocturnal.
